Beginner.learningGoal: Pass lambdas, use function types and return functions.
gotchas: A lambda that captures a var sees later updates
return inside a lambda returns from the enclosing function only if inline
Trailing lambda syntax moves the lambda outside the parentheses
shapeHints: applying a discount strategy passed as a lambda
a retry helper taking an operation lambda

Intermediate.learningGoal: Use inline functions, function references and compose functions.
gotchas: Non-local return is allowed only from inline lambdas
Function references to overloaded functions need type context
goodSolutionShows: Function references (::name) in place of trivial lambdas
shapeHints: a measure-and-return helper taking an injected clock
a pipeline composed of small functions

Advanced.learningGoal: Implement higher-order utilities with generics, currying and memoization.
gotchas: Memoization with a mutable map is not thread-safe, and recursive memoized functions modify the map during computation
Currying creates new closures per call
goodSolutionShows: Pure function tests with call counts
shapeHints: a memoize helper counting underlying invocations
a debounce-like helper using an injected clock
a generic compose with multiple arities
